recent: Pitlick was called up by Minnesota on Wednesday.
Entwistle was taken off the non-roster list and placed on waivers by Florida on Wednesday, per Elliotte Friedman of Sportsnet.
Dickinson (foot) will be in the lineup versus Anaheim on Wednesday, Oilers play-by-play announcer Jack Michaels reports.
Kuzmenko (personal) was granted non-roster status Wednesday and won't participate in Pittsburgh's road trip, per Josh Yohe of The Athletic.
Mangiapane (lower body) was put on injured reserve Wednesday.
